en.title: Anime Expeditions
en.description: Active Anime Expeditions codes for an anime tower defense strategy game with summons, story stages, challenges, infinite towers, and expeditions.
tips: Summon characters and build a balanced team for different enemy types.
Position units carefully to make the best use of their range and abilities.
Complete Story, Challenges, Infinite Towers, and Expeditions to earn resources.
Upgrade your units, reroll traits, and equip special items as you progress.

redeem.title: How to redeem codes in Anime Expeditions
redeem.description: Follow these steps to open the code menu and claim an active Anime Expeditions code.
steps: Launch Anime Expeditions from its official Roblox page and wait for the game to load.
Open the menu by clicking the three dots at the top of the screen.
Select Redeem Codes and paste an active code from the list above.
Confirm the redemption and check that the reward was added to your account.

redeem.title: Como resgatar códigos em Anime Expeditions
redeem.description: Siga estas etapas para abrir o menu de códigos e resgatar um código ativo de Anime Expeditions.
steps: Abra Anime Expeditions pela página oficial do Roblox e aguarde o jogo carregar.
Abra o menu clicando nos três pontinhos no topo da tela.
Selecione Redeem Codes e cole um código ativo da lista acima.
Confirme o resgate e verifique se a recompensa foi adicionada à sua conta.
